title: Juicy Briny Peruvian Tofu Anticuchos
description: A vegan-friendly Peruvian dish featuring marinated tofu, sherry, and a blend of spices, served in the traditional anticuchos form, bringing a nostalgic and savory flavor to your table.

ingredients.name: Extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into anticuchos sticks

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, ensuring the grates are clean and brush them with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together sherry vinegar, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to create the marinade.
Add the tofu sticks to the marinade, toss to coat evenly, and let marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove the tofu from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the tofu anticuchos for about 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are nicely charred and heated through.
Once cooked, remove the anticuchos from the heat and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve the anticuchos hot, with your choice of sides such as grilled vegetables, quinoa, or corn.
Offer additional marinade as a dipping sauce for added flavor.
